reason: A web-client plugin that improves the DeepSeek Harness slash-command skill menu with fuzzy matching across skill names and descriptions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的斜杠菜单提供基于名称和描述的模糊技能搜索与排序。
summaries.en: Adds fuzzy matching and ranking by skill name and description to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI slash-command menu.

capabilities: Modifies the web GUI slash-command skill menu
Performs client-side fuzzy matching and ranking of skill names and descriptions
Wraps the built-in skill source while preserving its roster and query behavior
